subject: Evaluation plan + MAP: commercial terms and discount request
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@grace-analytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Evaluation plan for Redwood — initial MAP and discount request

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — team was impressed with the latency profile and caching notes you shared. We prepared a short mutual action plan (attached) that aligns evaluation milestones to an expansion commit: 4-week pilot, followed by a 3-month ramp to a 10 GPU equivalent commitment.

To make the pilot viable for our internal stakeholders we need two commercial items addressed: a one-time pilot discount on usage (requested 30% off list for the pilot months) and a ramp-based pricing ladder tied to committed GPU-equivalent volume. The pilot discount is conditional on executing the MAP and committing to a Q3 upgrade if the evaluation meets the KPIs.

Can you confirm if Redwood can accept conditional discounts structured this way and what internal approvals would be required? I attached the MAP draft and a short procurement checklist. We are aiming to sign the MAP by 2026-03-10 to keep our Q2 evaluation calendar intact.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Director, Platform Procurement
Grace Analytics

Attachments: MAP_GraceAnalytics_v1.pdf, Procurement_Checklist.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@grace-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan for Redwood — initial MAP and discount request

Priya —

Really appreciate the clear MAP and the timeline. We can support a pilot structure + ramp ladder but discounts at 30% for the pilot are outside our standard delegated authority for AE-level approvals. Two quick items:

- I can approve up to 15% pilot credit from my quota. Anything beyond that needs a finance review and VP sign-off.
- We can structure the ramp pricing as a step function (0-3 GPU, 3-7 GPU, 7-10+ GPU) with commit-triggered pricing. Happy to draft a redline to your MAP and circulate.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll kick off an internal approval request (summary below) with finance and VP sales for the requested 30% pilot discount and the proposed ramp ladder.
2) If we get conditional approval we’ll send a final MAP + SOW and a DocuSign link for signature by 2026-03-10.

I’ve attached a short commercial summary (Financials_Grace_Ramp.xlsx) for internal review.

Vanessa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Financials_Grace_Ramp.xlsx
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation plan for Redwood — Grace Analytics (discount request, MAP) — please advise/approve

Team — forwarding the request from Grace Analytics. TL;DR: customer requests a 4-week pilot with 30% off usage during pilot window, conditional on executing the attached MAP and committing to a Q3 expansion to ~10 GPU-equivalent capacity on a 12-month committed plan.

Why this matters: Grace is a credible mid‑market analytics customer (large data footprint, potential to scale regionally). If they commit to the Q3 ramp we estimate ~$360k ARR on a 12‑month commit at target utilization, with upside in professional services and dedicated capacity.

Requested approvals:
- Pilot discount: 30% off usage for pilot months (Mar–Apr).
- Ramp: tiered commit pricing; willing to accept a structured rebate based on utilization tiers.

My recommendation: approve pilot discount up to 25% and require a signed MAP with measurable KPIs + an agreed onboarding plan; anything above 25% should be escalated to VP sales + CFO for final sign-off.

I’ve attached: MAP_GraceAnalytics_v1.pdf, Financials_Grace_Ramp.xlsx, SOW_GraceAnalytics_v1.docx

Can you please reply with decision by COB 3 Mar so I can keep their target sign date?

— Vanessa
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation plan for Redwood — Grace Analytics (discount request, MAP) — please advise/approve

Vanessa — thanks for the summary and the corridor analysis. Two points from me:

1) Strategic fit: Grace is a priority target for our analytics vertical; we should be flexible on pilot economics if it materially increases probability of a committed deployment.
2) Discount guardrails: I’ll approve up to 30% pilot discount on the condition that Finance (Vivek) signs off on the ARR profile and legal signs off on the MAP language limiting pilot credit to usage only (no credits for SLA). Anything >30% requires CEO sign-off per our discount policy.

Vivek — can you confirm finance comfort with the ARR math? If yes, I’ll sign off and Vanessa can send an approved MAP with explicit ramp milestones. If not, we should counter with a 25% pilot credit + a modest onboarding credit to hit the effective concession they requested.

-Rishi
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation plan for Redwood — Grace Analytics (discount request, MAP) — finance review

Reviewed the financials (see attached spreadsheet notes). With the ramp assumptions in Vanessa’s model the expected committed ARR justifies up to a 30% pilot concession for the first two months, provided two controls are enforced:

1) The pilot discount is applied only to metered API usage (no credits on infra pass-through or support addons).
2) The MAP must include a measurable KPI gate (latency and cost per 1M tokens) and a binding commitment to execute a paid upgrade to the committed plan within 60 days of successful pilot.

If you want anything beyond 30% (e.g., 40%), per discount policy that requires CEO approval. Rishi — you have my green light for 30% with the listed controls.

-Vivek
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@grace-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 17:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evaluation plan for Redwood — MAP and pilot discount (approved)

Priya — good news and thank you for the quick turnaround. We have internal approval for a 30% pilot usage credit for the two-month evaluation, subject to the controls below. We’re happy to proceed to signature and will issue a DocuSign package with MAP + SOW once you confirm.

Approved commercial summary (key bullets):
- Pilot: 2 months, 30% usage credit applied to Redwood metered usage only (Mar–Apr).
- KPI gate: agreed latency targets and throughput KPIs defined in Appendix A of the MAP.
- Commitment: Grace to execute a 12-month committed plan for ~10 GPU-equivalent capacity within 60 days of successful pilot. Ramp ladder and pricing tiers included in SOW.
- Exclusions: credits do not apply to 3rd-party infra pass-through, professional services, or premium support add-ons.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of these points and return the signed MAP by 2026-03-10.
2) I’ll send the DocuSign packet (MAP + SOW) and a short onboarding checklist.

Appreciate the collaboration — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_GraceAnalytics_v1.pdf, SOW_GraceAnalytics_v1.docx
